newsitem.title: INDIA: Laos seeks Indian help in revving up economy.
newsitem.headline: Laos seeks Indian help in revving up economy.

text.p: Laos, a late-comer to market reform, is seeking India's help to boost economic growth and emulate fast-growing southeast Asian neighbours, Laotian Prime Minister Khamtay Siphandone said on Friday.
"We hope cooperation with other countries, especially India, will help our country develop," Khamtay, who arrived in India on Thursday for a five-day visit, told reporters.
"Henceforth, Laos will concentrate on her preparations for membership in ASEAN (Association of South East Asian Nations) this year," the prime minister later told Indian businessmen.

Laos has embarked on a reform programme to end state controls on the economy.
